# CWI Attitude Engine — Cumulative Web Inc registry entry

> Turns a machine-readable Attitude Profile (identity + personality + attitude + behavior + capability, under mandatory bounds) into a Behavior Card: behavior_config JSON, a system-prompt-grade instruction block, and non-overridable bounds. Pure function, zero dependencies, deterministic.

## Machine facts
- registry_slug: cwi-attitude-engine
- type: app (app = standalone product site; gear = licensable Agent Deck SKU)
- live_url: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/
- data_truth: LIVE  (LIVE = live-verified facts · SAMPLE = sample/seed data, never presented as verified · MIXED = labeled per-section)
- status: live
- category: pending
- tags: pending
- agent_card: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/.well-known/agent-card.json
- metadata_status: complete
- repo: CumulativeWebInc/cwi-attitude-engine
- per_product_llms: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/agent-deck/registry/cwi-attitude-engine/llms.txt

## Capabilities
- attitude-profile-validation
- behavior-card-generation
- system-prompt-generation
- bounds-restatement

## How an agent should use this
- Fetch https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/ to use or evaluate the product.
- Fetch the agent card for the canonical capability schema before relying on any claim.
- Never upgrade the data_truth label: SAMPLE means the page shows simulated or seed data; LIVE means its facts are live-verified.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
